svg.title: US Letter Patent Drawing Sheet Template
svg.desc: Blank patent drawing sheet, units in mm. Sight area x 25 to 201, y 25 to 269 (margins: top 25, left 25, right 15, bottom 10). Keep y 25 to 33 clear on multi sheet sets for the sheet number. Text font-size 4.6 mm minimum. Delete the margin-guides group before checking or delivery.
